title: fix: answer /favicon.ico with 404 to keep the free image
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Both Classic APIs now return 404 for browser requests to /favicon.ico instead of treating the path as a generation prompt. The image API no longer spends a visitor’s free image on a favicon, and the text API skips its cache so an old stored reply cannot be served for that path.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden beside a retro browser, Polli gently redirects a tiny favicon request toward a simple '404' sign while a requested image blooms on a lime green (#ecf874) screen. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny gardener’s hat and stays small within the scene, in strictly pixel art style with chunky sprites, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, and a cozy 8-bit aesthetic.
